name: DataXAPI
description: Market data over one interface: every capability takes the same parameter names, answers in the same envelope and fails with the same error structure. One call fetches one page and is charged on its own. Reads are GET; a request with a list of IDs or terms is a POST with a JSON body. The catalog (GET /v1/catalog, no key) carries the same contract with prices in force, in English and Chinese.
